text:
Ash Patel: spinning up eu-west-2 GPU pool in the new account. need a quick security baseline for the cluster: IAM roles, secrets, KMS/HSM, policy checks. Any immediate gotchas?

Miguel Ortega: short checklist:
- IAM: least-privilege roles + IRSA for workloads
- Secrets: Secrets Manager / sealed secrets, CMK-encrypted
- KMS: customer-managed CMK, rotation enabled, alias naming
- Audit: CloudTrail + CloudWatch logs to locked bucket
- Network: no public bastion, SSM only, restricted egress
- Policy scan: run policy-scan + CIS EKS

Samira Chen: Add HSM note: if the tenant requires FIPS/HSM, provision CloudHSM (or HSM-backed KMS) and plan +1 week. I'll own policy sign-off.

Miguel Ortega: example TF snippets (role trust + kms key):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "gpu_node_role" {
  name = "redwood-gpu-node-role"
  assume_role_policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"ec2.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}
  ]
}
POLICY
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "cmk" {
  description             = "CMK for redwood-cluster-eu-west-2"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation     = true
  policy                  = <<POLICY
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Sid":"Enable IAM User Permissions","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},"Action":"kms:*","Resource":"*"}]
}
POLICY
}
```

Ash Patel: thanks. Which policies should be attached to node vs workload roles?

Miguel Ortega: nodes: minimal EC2/EBS/ENI/ECR pull permissions, SSM Session Manager. Workload (IRSA): only AWS APIs it needs (S3 read-only, DynamoDB ops, no broad *).

Leo Vargas: ops reminder: block public S3, enable VPC endpoints for S3 and ECR, and put the audit bucket on a separate management account with bucket policy preventing deletes.

deploy-bot: policy-scan: initial scan completed with 2 warnings: [S3 public access block not enabled], [KMS key rotation disabled on alias redwood-cmk-temp]

Samira Chen: I'll remediate the S3 block and toggle rotation. Also ensure CloudTrail is centralized and immutable. For HSM customers we must record key provenance & attestation.

Miguel Ortega: also add pre-handoff checks:
- IRSA OIDC provider exists
- All service accounts have least-privilege policies
- Secrets encrypted with CMK and have rotation lifecycle
- KMS key alias and key policy include admin principals and monitoring
- CIS EKS automated scan passes

Ash Patel: handoff checklist for eng-sre runbook:
- IAM roles created and reviewed
- Secrets created + encrypted with CMK
- CMK rotation enabled / HSM flagged if required
- Network controls (SSM only, no public SSH)
- Policy-scan passed
- Canary node healthy for 30m
- Security sign-off @Samira

Samira Chen: I'll sign off once the above are green. Note: if customer enables HSM, expect higher latency on key ops and extra billing. I'll post cost estimate to #finance later.

Leo Vargas: cost FYI: CloudHSM cluster ~= $XXX/month + per-hour. Using KMS multi-region keys also carries cross-region replication cost.

Ash Patel: OK proceeding with canary. Will ping here when it's up and attach the policy-scan output. Thanks all :pray:

Miguel Ortega: one last tip — tag resources with `team:infra` and `env:staging|prod` so policy-scan picks them up properly.
